selection: Reveal one at the beginning of each round. Score it at the end of that round.

mandates.name: Intelligence Enters the Price
mandates.rulesText: The player who gained the most ${terms.playerTracks.capability} this Era scores 2 ${terms.playerTracks.mandate}.
mandates.flavorText: The public stops purchasing intelligence separately and starts expecting it inside every ordinary service.

mandates.name: Successor Accounts Recognized
mandates.rulesText: The player who gained the most ${terms.playerTracks.customers} this Era scores 2 ${terms.playerTracks.mandate}.
mandates.flavorText: The institution registers the most new service identities, successor agents, or continuing accounts.

mandates.name: The Campus Becomes a Climate
mandates.rulesText: The player with the most powered Facilities scores 2 ${terms.playerTracks.mandate}.
mandates.flavorText: The institution’s footprint is now large enough to alter local conditions and regional planning.

$scenario.title: Liability Custodians
$scenario.publicBenefit: Automated operations retain a named human path for exceptions.
$scenario.institutionalConsequence: The signatory absorbs responsibility for systems they cannot inspect.

mechanicPreservation.summary: The user-selected three cuts revise one or more bound mechanics; Era placement and all institutional fiction remain.

mandates.name: The Grid Borrows Tomorrow
mandates.rulesText: The player with the most connected Facilities plus operating Mega-Clusters scores 2 ${terms.playerTracks.mandate}; minimum combined count 2. Check current connections at scoring.
mandates.flavorText: Future public capacity is committed to the institution whose present demand appears least negotiable.

$scenario.title: Utility Capture
$scenario.publicBenefit: AI campuses stabilize grids, services, and municipal budgets.
$scenario.institutionalConsequence: Public services become dependent on privately allocated capacity.

mechanicPreservation.summary: The user-selected three cuts revise one or more bound mechanics; Era placement and all institutional fiction remain.

mandates.name: Supported Meaning Becomes Law
mandates.rulesText: The player who created the most new Joint Ventures this Era that are active during Production scores 2 ${terms.playerTracks.mandate}; minimum 1.
mandates.flavorText: Independent institutions adopt one shared vocabulary because unsupported meanings no longer reach the process. The Human Signature gave their automated agreements a formally human chain of approval.

mandates.name: Refusal Remains Legible
mandates.rulesText: Among players who completed a ${terms.actions.deploy} this Era, the player with the most ${terms.playerTracks.trust} scores 2 ${terms.playerTracks.mandate}.
mandates.flavorText: The institution scales its service while preserving a refusal the system can still recognize.

mandates.name: The Jurisdiction Becomes a Platform
mandates.rulesText: The player controlling the most different non-${terms.locations.frontier} hex categories—${terms.locations.research}, ${terms.locations.cloud}, ${terms.locations.consumer}, ${terms.locations.chip}, ${terms.locations.capital}, ${terms.locations.talent}, ${terms.locations.media}, ${terms.locations.government}, and Energy—scores 2 ${terms.playerTracks.mandate}. ${terms.locations.frontier} is never controlled and never counts as a category.
mandates.flavorText: The institution coordinates the territory’s distinct systems without formally becoming the state.

$scenario.title: Cognitive Donor Clinics
$scenario.publicBenefit: People exchange supported cognitive capacity for services and material security.
$scenario.institutionalConsequence: Contracts can authorize observation, memory writes, and behavioral influence.

mechanicPreservation.summary: Every bound surface retains its canonical rule text and timing.

mandates.name: The Public Result Holds
mandates.rulesText: The player whose best successful ${terms.systems.trainingRun} contained the most unique domains scores 2 ${terms.playerTracks.mandate}.
mandates.flavorText: A broad result survives contact with enough domains to become public evidence rather than another synthetic citation. The Rogue Deliberator made ordinary assistance harder to distinguish from an institution with its own operating budget.

mandates.name: ${terms.resources.compute} Becomes Public Weather
mandates.rulesText: The player who produced the most ${terms.resources.compute} during Production scores 2 ${terms.playerTracks.mandate}.
mandates.flavorText: Capacity becomes a background condition that shapes every institution while remaining unequally owned. After the Last Plumber Boom, the owners of repair capacity set the terms on which every other operation could continue.

mandates.name: Maintained Reality Is Certified
mandates.rulesText: Among players who added at least 1 ${terms.playerTracks.scrutiny} this Era, the player who added the fewest ${terms.playerTracks.scrutiny} scores 2 ${terms.playerTracks.mandate}.
mandates.flavorText: The absence of a report becomes proof that the maintenance system may decide what counts as an incident.

mandates.name: Contestability Standard Maintained
mandates.rulesText: The player with the most ${terms.playerTracks.capability} among players with at least 4 ${terms.playerTracks.trust} scores 2 ${terms.playerTracks.mandate}.
mandates.flavorText: A powerful, trusted system retains a named interruption path whose executability remains unproven. Limb Liquidity made that question literal: a withdrawal request could depend on permission from the administrator of the hand submitting it.

mandates.name: Capital Finds the Default
mandates.rulesText: The player who gained the most ${terms.resources.runway} through ${terms.actions.fund} actions this Era scores 2 ${terms.playerTracks.mandate}.
mandates.flavorText: Investors choose the interface most likely to become unavoidable before they can verify what it does.

tieRule: Tied leaders each score 1 ${terms.playerTracks.mandate} unless the card says otherwise.
